entry.title: Glass Spheres 1.1.0
entry.summary: Mutable Instruments Marbles' random generators as an MPC plugin: random gates and voltages to the MPC X's CV/Gate jacks, or played as MIDI notes and CCs, with two envelopes, two LFOs, an 8-slot modulation matrix and a built-in manual. **1.1.0 is built with Akai's official MPC Plugin SDK** and runs on **MPC OS 3.10.1** with Enhancements → External Plugin Support. No modded firmware or root access needed any more. ## What's new - **Modulation on the main page:** a teal dot circles each of the seve
